description.value: Sportsman's Steakhouse is a sit-down restaurant in the Port Hardy area of northern Vancouver Island, one of BC's most remote cycling destinations. The Facebook page slug hints the menu extends to pizza, suggesting a casual multi-item diner rather than a pure steakhouse. For touring cyclists reaching this far-north corner of the island, it represents one of the few full-service dining options in the area.
